pages.title: Corruption Spreads
pages.text: $(curse)Cursed blocks$() are the physical manifestation of the Khamsin Curse. They spread slowly, corrupting the land around them.$(br2)Standing on cursed ground drains your $(gold)Ankh$() rapidly.

pages.title: Cursed Block Types
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Cursed Earth$(): Corrupted soil$(li)$(item)Cursed Stone$(): Tainted rock$(li)$(item)Cursed Sand$(): Dark sand$(li)$(item)Cursed Log$(): Dead wood$(li)$(item)Cursed Wood Plank$(): Warped planks

pages.title: Cursed Plants
pages.text: Unnatural vegetation grows on cursed ground:$(br2)$(li)$(item)Bloodshade Thicket$()$(li)$(item)Cursed Sprig$()$(li)$(item)Duat Fern$()$(li)$(item)Vine of Apep$()$(li)$(item)Isfet Frond$()$(li)$(item)Sutekh Coil$()

pages.title: Cleansing
pages.text: Remove cursed blocks using:$(br2)$(li)$(item)Purification Staff$() + salt circle$(li)$(item)Solar Spire$() activation$(li)$(item)Eternal Sigil$() divine power$(br2)See $(l:getting_started/purification)Purifying the Land$(/l).
